notes: Read both units, full Biden-Harris first-term and preamble context, all twenty-four candidates and the review. Reattributed all nineteen achievement claims to Democrats and the Biden-Harris administration, anchored national and publication-era scope, and resolved factories, infrastructure and the border to the United States. Removed the unresolvable substantive meaning of right to choose rather than guessing it, normalized the hate metaphor, and restored the statement that much more remains to be done.

claims.claim_text: Democrats credit the Biden-Harris administration with creating nearly 16 million U.S. jobs.
Democrats say a record number of U.S. small businesses were starting in 2024.
Democrats credit the Biden-Harris administration with returning factories to the United States.
Democrats credit the administration with lowering family health-insurance premiums.
Democrats credit it with confronting pharmaceutical companies to lower prescription-drug prices.
Democrats say the administration was helping students recover learning losses.
Democrats say it was forgiving millions of student loans characterized as crushing.
Democrats credit it with passing the first significant U.S. gun-safety law in decades.
Democrats credit it with record public-safety investment and putting more police officers on patrol.
Democrats say U.S. violent crime in 2024 was at its lowest level in fifty years.
Democrats credit it with fighting climate change, reducing pollution and fueling clean-energy growth.
Democrats say it was rebuilding U.S. roads, bridges, highways, ports, airports and water systems.
Democrats credit it with seizing record amounts of fentanyl.
Democrats credit it with securing the U.S. border despite what they characterize as Republican inaction.
Democrats say it was closing the U.S. racial wealth gap.
Democrats say it was closing the U.S. gender pay gap.
Democrats credit it with expanding benefits and services for veterans exposed to toxins.
Democrats credit it with strengthening NATO.
Democrats credit it with restoring U.S. leadership worldwide.
Democrats state that substantially more work remains.
Democrats would continue rejecting every form of political violence and refuse to tolerate or protect hate.

unresolved_references: The target does not identify the substantive right meant by “the right to choose,” so candidate 21 is excluded rather than resolved by assumption.
